name: E. Kessler
bio: E. Kessler of New York spent a month hunting at Jack McGregor's ranch in fall 1885 and took several fine heads. While hunting below the mouth of Beaver Creek with Tommy McGregor, he came upon two bears feeding.

moments.label: Came upon two bears while hunting

mentions: E. Kessler of New York, returned home last Monday, after a month's hunting at Jack McGregor's ranch. He had moderately good luck, securing several fine heads.

…last week were: J E Hample, Chicago; J L Truscott, R quarter circle ranch; R Launchbaugh, Custer, Montana; E Kessler, New York; A H Scale, Chicago; Dr. Heber Robarts, Dickinson; John Crosby, Medora; B Barr, Kansas City; J H Buster, Hashknife camp.
